name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero
description: Castellated 23.5 x 18 mm ESP32-S3FH4R2 board (4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM) with USB-C, WS2812 RGB LED and 24 GPIOs; the compact S3 for soldering straight onto a PCB.
notes: Pin order with USB-C at the top: left 5V, GND, 3V3(out), GP1-GP6; right TX, RX, GP13-GP7; GP14, 15, 16 on the bottom edge and GP17, 18, 38-42, 45 on underside pads. Rows are 15.24 mm apart (no mechanical drawing, so no header data).
WS2812 RGB LED data on GPIO21; BOOT and RESET buttons. Native USB only (no UART bridge): hold BOOT while plugging in to flash.
Sold without headers; the '-M' variant ships with headers soldered. Input 3.7-6 V on the 5V pad.
